sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Metagolem: Icon of History''' is one of the biggest [[Titans]] the [[Huntik Foundation]] has access to. With 5 ATK and 6 DEF, he is incredibly strong, but the trick is emptying your hand before you play it. Metagolem may be teamed with with [[SAS-001|Caliban: Dante's Titan]] since Caliban makes you discard a card each round. Caliban's drawback can actually helps you out. Other Actions that let you quickly use up the cards in your hand are useful for invoking Metagolem, too.
